extracted.intended_audience: EU policymakers, European Commission staff, national administrations and stakeholders involved in designing, assessing, consulting on and implementing EU policies and legislation
extracted.subtask_description: A structured toolbox of principles, methods and procedural guidance for designing, assessing (impact assessments, evaluations, fitness checks), consulting stakeholders, monitoring, and ensuring compliance in EU policymaking and regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #1. Principles, procedures & exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles, procedures and exceptions relevant to better regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #2. The regulatory fitness programme (REFIT) and the Fit for Future Platform
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the REFIT programme and the Fit for Future Platform for regulatory fitness.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #3. Role of the Regulatory Scrutiny Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the role of the Regulatory Scrutiny Board in the better regulation process.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #4. Evidence-informed policymaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on using evidence to inform policymaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #5. Legal basis, subsidiarity and proportionality
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on determining legal basis, applying subsidiarity and proportionality principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #6. Planning and validation of initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on planning and validating policy and legislative initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #7. What is an impact assessment and when it is necessary
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of an impact assessment and criteria for when one is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #8. What steps should be followed for an impact assessment?
rubrics_metrics.description: Stepwise procedural guidance for carrying out an impact assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #9. Spending programmes, financial instruments and budgetary guarantee
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing spending programmes, financial instruments and budgetary guarantees in impact assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #10. Treaty-based social partner consultations and initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on consultations and initiatives involving social partners under Treaty requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #11. Format of the impact assessment report
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the required format and structure of an impact assessment report.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #12. How to apply proportionality to impact assessments
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on proportionate application of assessment effort relative to the initiative.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #13. How to analyse problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on problem analysis techniques for impact assessments and evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #14. Risk assessment and management
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying, assessing and managing risks in policymaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #15. How to set objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on defining clear, measurable objectives for initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #16. How to identify policy options
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on generating and selecting feasible policy options.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #17. The choice of policy instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on selecting appropriate policy instruments to achieve objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #18. Identification of impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying the range of impacts (economic, social, environmental, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #19. Sustainable development goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on integrating Sustainable Development Goals into impact assessments and evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #20. Strategic foresight for impact assessments and evaluations
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on using strategic foresight methods in impact assessments and evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #21. Competitiveness check
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing impacts on competitiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #22. Research and innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on accounting for research and innovation impacts and considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #23. The ‘SME test’
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing impacts on small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #24. Competition
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing effects on market competition.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #25. Internal market
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on internal market impacts and considerations for EU-level action.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #26. Prevention of fraud
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying and preventing fraud-related risks in initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #27. External trade and investment
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing external trade and investment impacts of proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #28. Digital-ready policymaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on ensuring policies are fit for the digital transition and digital technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #29. Fundamental rights, including the promotion of equality
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing impacts on fundamental rights and equality considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #30. Employment, working conditions, income distribution, social protection and inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing social impacts including employment, working conditions and inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #31. Education and training, culture and youth (ETCY)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on impacts related to education, training, culture and youth.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #32. Health impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing health-related impacts of policies and legislation.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #33. Consumers
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on consumer-related impacts and consumer protection considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #34. Territorial impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on territorial (regional/local) impacts and territorial cohesion considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #35. Developing countries
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on impacts for developing countries and external development considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #36. Environmental impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying and assessing environmental impacts, including methodological approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #37. Customs enforcement of sectoral prohibitions and restrictions at EU borders
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on customs enforcement issues for sectoral prohibitions and restrictions at EU borders.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #38. Compliance promotion and verification tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on tools and approaches to promote and verify compliance with EU rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #39. Compliance assessment: explanatory documents, transposition and conformity checks
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing compliance, drafting explanatory documents, and conducting transposition and conformity checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #40. Drafting the explanatory memorandum
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on drafting the explanatory memorandum that accompanies legislative proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #41. Guidance documents containing legal interpretation of EU law
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on when and how to produce guidance documents that interpret EU law.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #42. Delegated and implementing acts
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the use and drafting of delegated and implementing acts.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #43. Monitoring arrangements and indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on setting up monitoring arrangements and selecting indicators to track policy performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #44. Legal provisions on monitoring and evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on legal requirements for monitoring and evaluation provisions in legislation.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #45. What is an evaluation and when it is required
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of evaluations and criteria for when an evaluation is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #46. Designing the evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on designing evaluations, including scope, methods and planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #47. Evaluation criteria and questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on standard evaluation criteria and sample evaluation questions to assess policy performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #48. Conducting the evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidance on carrying out evaluations and collecting evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #49. Format of the evaluation report
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the required format and structure of evaluation reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #50. ‘Back-to-back’ evaluations and impact assessments
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on conducting linked or simultaneous evaluations and impact assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #51. Consulting stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on principles and practices for consulting stakeholders during policy development.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #52. Consultation strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on developing a consultation strategy (who to consult, timing, methods).

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #53. Conducting consultation activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidance on running consultation activities (surveys, hearings, meetings, online consultations).

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #54. Analysing data and informing policymaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on analysing consultation data and using results to inform policy choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #55. Horizontal matters – publication of responses, data protection, access to documents and transparency register
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on horizontal issues for consultations including publication of responses, data protection, access to documents and transparency register rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #56. Typology of costs and benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on categorising types of costs and benefits in impact analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #57. Methods to assess costs and benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on methodological approaches for assessing costs and benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #58. EU Standard Cost Model
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on applying the EU Standard Cost Model for administrative burden measurement.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #59. Cost estimates and the ‘one in, one out’ approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on producing cost estimates and applying the 'one in, one out' approach to regulatory costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #60. Baselines
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on defining and using baselines in impact assessments and evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #61. Simulation models
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on use of simulation models to project impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #62. Multi-criteria decision analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on applying multi-criteria decision analysis in policy appraisal.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #63. Cost-benefit analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on performing cost-benefit analysis for policy options.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #64. Discount factors
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on choosing and applying discount factors in economic appraisal.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #65. Uncertainty and sensitivity analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on addressing uncertainty and conducting sensitivity analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #66. Life cycle assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on life cycle assessment methods for environmental impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #67. Data identification for evaluation and impact assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying and sourcing appropriate data for assessments and evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #68. Methods for evaluating causal effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on methods to evaluate causal effects of interventions (impact attribution).

rubrics_metrics.name: TOOL #69. Emerging methods and policy instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on emerging analytical methods and novel policy instruments.
